name: Pellucid Biolab Standard Coat
description:
A knee-length lab coat in a clean white poly-cotton blend with snap closures rather than buttons for faster removal in contamination situations. Two large lower pockets, two chest pockets, a pen slot sewn into the left breast. The fabric has a tight weave that resists light liquid splatter and holds a press well — after a shift it looks like you've been working, not like you've been through something.

Pellucid is the dominant supplier of professional lab and medical workwear throughout GLMZ's licensed research sector. This coat is standard issue at geneware clinics, university labs, corporate R&D facilities, and the many gray-market clinics that operate in the transition zones between tiers. The same coat on a Tier 4 researcher and a back-alley gene-splicer — the coat itself makes no judgment.
what_it_says: You work in a lab or want people to think you do. In this city, both are plausible.
story_hooks: A Pellucid lab coat found at an unauthorized geneware site has a corponation R&D facility ID badge still clipped to the chest pocket — the researcher it belonged to is listed as on sabbatical.

Pellucid has introduced a new batch of coats with a slightly different chemical composition in the fabric — someone with the right instruments would notice it reacts to a specific airborne compound used in a classified corponation process.
Gray-market clinics have been getting shipments of Pellucid coats with corponation lab insignia already embroidered — someone inside Pellucid is helping unauthorized operations look legitimate.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions ChemoShield BX-2 Dermal Toxin Barrier Implant

physical_description.visual_profile: A crisp, utilitarian knee-length coat with a clinical silhouette. Clean lines and professional geometry create an impression of competence and sterility. The white fabric catches light evenly, suggesting order and precision. Despite its uniform appearance, wear patterns and subtle stains tell stories of actual labor.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through the body with tapered sleeves. Cut to allow layering over augmentation rigs and sensor arrays. Generous enough for movement during delicate work, structured enough to maintain a professional appearance throughout a shift.
physical_description.primary_material: Poly-cotton blend (80/20 synthetic-organic ratio). Tight weave construction treats the surface against light splatter and chemical micro-particles. The fabric has a slight sheen from synthetic component, distinguishing it from pure organic cotton.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and pressed when new, develops a subtle hand-worn texture at stress points. The tight weave creates a faint grid pattern visible under direct light. Resists wrinkling but accepts creasing at elbows and knees from repeated movement.
physical_description.color_scheme: Institutional white as primary. Subtle gray cast from manufacturing process and inevitable workplace wear. Pale ecru undertones appear with age. Pellucid branding in minimal sans-serif gray at left chest pocket.
physical_description.closures: Snap closures (not buttons) down the front — medical-grade stainless steel snaps rated for rapid removal in contamination protocols. Snaps placed at 4-inch intervals for full-torso accessibility.
distinctive_features: Two oversized lower pockets with reinforced stress-seams — engineered to hold lab equipment, sample containers, or black-market augmentation supplies
Chest-level pen slot on left breast in matching thread, faded from repeated use
Two smaller chest pockets with snap closures for secure containment
Seam-sealed inside collar reinforcement at neck — common point of contamination concern
Subtle Pellucid logo embroidered in gray thread, low-visibility branding typical of Tier 2-3 professional wear
Fabric weight and construction designed to show wear patterns rather than stains — darker shadowing at high-contact areas
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 boundary. Standard professional workwear across licensed and unlicensed sectors. Cost-effective enough for institutional bulk purchase, quality sufficient to withstand daily use across all tiers. Worn equally in gleaming Tier 2 corporate biotech facilities and gray-market Tier 4 clinics operating in transition zones.
physical_description.cultural_context: The wearer claims authority in biological sciences, medical practice, or research sectors. Signals competence, access to restricted areas, and familiarity with contamination protocols. In Tier 5 contexts, wearing this coat indicates either skilled gene-work experience or aspirational professional identity. The coat itself carries no moral judgment — it legitimizes authority in labs both licensed and clandestine.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and weathered with visible history. White fabric yellowed slightly at collar and wrists from handling and minor chemical exposure. Faint stain marks (bleached rather than visible) across torso and pockets from countless shift cycles. Snaps occasionally scratched from heavy use. Hem may show subtle fraying or careful hand-repair. Despite wear, maintains structured silhouette — this is professional damage, not decay.
